scripts.verify:web: bash -c 'pnpm run docs:test && pnpm run workspace:test && pnpm run packages:check && pnpm run packages:test && pnpm run web:check && pnpm run web:test && pnpm run web:build'
scripts.workspace:test: node --test tests/guards/workspace-layout.test.mjs tests/guards/packages-consumers.test.mjs tests/guards/shared-boundary.test.mjs tests/guards/url-validation-boundary.test.mjs tests/guards/web-bundle-budget.test.mjs tests/guards/config-typescript.test.mjs tests/guards/config-quality.test.mjs tests/guards/domain-boundaries.test.mjs tests/guards/docs-coverage.test.mjs tests/guards/workspace-workflows.test.mjs
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && find . -name 'node_modules' -prune -o -name '.turbo' -print | xargs rm -rf
scripts.clean:dist: find apps packages -name 'dist' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find apps packages -name 'build' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find apps packages -name '.next' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} +
